episodes.synopsis: Sorata is a normal student living in an abnormal dorm and has one goal: ESCAPE! But those plans are thrown when a new student moves in.
episodes.title: Cat - White - Mashiro

episodes.synopsis: Sorata is tasked with watching over Shiina Mashiro, her naivety is slowing corrupting his life.
episodes.title: I Drew a Picture

episodes.synopsis: Sorata’s determination to move out of Sakura Hall is being questioned by his dorm mates. As he tries to distance himself from Shiina, rumor of her visiting a love hotel causes him to rush to her.
episodes.title: So Close And Yet So Far

episodes.synopsis: Big changes are happening at the Hall when Sorata finally makes his decision. Will the other residents admit their true feelings, too?
episodes.title: A World of Changing

episodes.synopsis: A new girl is moving into Sakura Hall and things are going to get even more awkward.
episodes.title: The Serious Girl of Sakura Hall

episodes.synopsis: Nanami has overworked herself with taking care of Shiina, her jobs, and voice acting school. Her midterm presentation is coming up and she is in no shape to take it. Can Sorata do anything to help her?
episodes.title: The Blue After the Rain

episodes.synopsis: If Mashiro and Nanami weren’t enough, Sorata has to deal with someone who has known him all his life. The jealousy between these three rivals will bring Sorata to his knees.
episodes.title: Her Homesickness

episodes.synopsis: Sorata has based the first round of the game competition! His time is now devoted to mastering his oral presentation and dealing with Mashiro new found interest in discovering what love is.
episodes.title: Set Off a Huge Firework

episodes.synopsis: One night, Mashiro's English school friend, Rita, turns up on the doorstep to flip everyone's world upside-down. Meanwhile, the gang finally meets the elusive occupant of Room 102: Akasaka Ryunosuke!
episodes.title: The Fall Storm is Here

episodes.synopsis: Work on Nyapollon is starting to back up; the idea is to bring in an additional artist. But the only one who can match Mashiro’s work is Rita…
episodes.title: Hate Hate, Love

episodes.synopsis: Even though the festival has started, a last minute change by Sorata has everyone in Sakura Hall rushing to implement his changes.
episodes.title: Milky Way Cat, Nyapollon

episodes.synopsis: The production of Milky Way Cat, Nyapollon is going well until the audience is asked to “Shout your love”. Who will be the first to speak up?
episodes.title: The Power of Love in the Culture Festival

episodes.synopsis: The residents of Sakura house continue to enjoy the fame of their successful show, but as it begin to fade as Christmas approaches and the idea, the thought, and the want for love begins to take over.
episodes.title: One Step Before Winter

episodes.synopsis: Christmas Eve will be the night when truths are aired among the residents. But more than one person will have their heart broken.
episodes.title: The Windows and Lights of Christmas Eve

episodes.synopsis: Sorata gets roped into taking the women of Sakura Hall to his home, where he must contend against his manly father and bro-con sister.
episodes.title: Where is My Usual Self?

episodes.synopsis: The results of Sorata hard work and prep will finally show when he submits his pitch. At the same time, Nanami is prepping for her next chance.
episodes.title: I've Always Loved You

episodes.synopsis: Mashiro has asked Sorata to meet her on the roof, his mind races considering today is Valentine’s Day. But a frantic call from Nanami throws everything out the window.
episodes.title: Valentine's Day is Chocolate Day

episodes.synopsis: Time is running out for Jin and Misaki; their friends rush to bring them together, but the past makes an invisible barrier.
episodes.title: First Love with an Alien

episodes.synopsis: The shock of Sakura Hall closing has Sorata remembering his first days of moving into the hall and the cats his picked up along the way.
episodes.title: There's No Place Like Sakura Hall

episodes.synopsis: The residents start a campaign to save Sakura Hall but one resident is the lone holdout.
episodes.title: In Order To Keep Saying We're Home

episodes.synopsis: Sometimes you have to let go of a dream and face reality.
episodes.title: It's Not Anyone's Fault That It Rains

episodes.synopsis: Mahiro knows she is the reason for Sakura hall closing, as she prepares to leave school to protect those she loves. The residents search desperately to find her.
episodes.title: Run Through Those Sparkling Days

episodes.synopsis: Fight to the very end!
episodes.title: Graduation Ceremony

episodes.synopsis: A new school year is starting with new and old faces.
episodes.title: Welcome to Sakura Hall
